correctness.rationale: In characteristic two, the partial derivatives of F=y^4+xz^3+x^3z are z(x+z)^2, 0, x(x+z)^2; together with F=0 they yield precisely p=[1:0:1]. The explicit normalization [u:v]->[u^4:uv(u+v)^2:v^4] lands on F, is birational by t=Y(1+Z)/(1+Z+Y^2), and has unique preimage q=[1:1] of p. A projective stabilizer lifts to PGL2 preserving V=<u^4,v^4,uv(u+v)^2> and fixing q. For g=(a b;c d), fixing q gives d=a+b+c; the u^2v^2 coefficient is (ad+bc)(ab+cd), so invertibility forces (a+c)(b+c)=0. The a=c branch has determinant zero; hence b=c,d=a. Normalize a+b=1 to obtain the displayed g_lambda and induced T_lambda. Direct independent symbolic mod-2 checks confirm the normalization, rational inverse, condition factorization, F(T_lambda)=F, and T_lambda T_mu=T_(lambda+mu). On r=v/(u+v) outside q the action is r->r+lambda, proving simple transitivity on the smooth locus. Does not assess nonreduced group scheme or nonprojective curve automorphisms.
